## 03 — Opening family and both alpha positions

Crop `readers/026/A/crop_02_family.png`; SHA-256 `2d1aee1051346817db7b57e8653329fe34871111a042fbbd5a403c8d87615273`. Loci: S01, L003.

Inside the two parentheses, the Sigma has a short dark horizontal upper run separated by white paper from the descending upper diagonal and lower zigzag/foot. A looped alpha is written above-right and another looped alpha below-right; the lower one is not omitted. After the closing parenthesis a third alpha precedes the membership sign. The final family sign has a tall double-curved E-like body, a low loop and a long rightward foot. Its calligraphic/script alphabet remains underdetermined at this resolution. Retain the complete Sigma-alpha-alpha state and the local upper-run qualification from A; retain both its glyph-head and independent-run alternatives without assigning the independent run a named hand. The family sign keeps mathcal E first, mathscr E and varepsilon alternatives, and should use B's exact EFAM literal drawing so its observed loop and foot remain represented. C026-R01 stays retained. The visible alpha placements and membership are high confidence; the head attachment and family alphabet are medium confidence. H's opening occurrence lacks the lower alpha present in the crop.

## 05 — The wording after topologique

Crop `readers/026/B/crops/02_interest.png`; SHA-256 `edaa8fee90528cfa5281aed7add6c7ad155479e8d8a51ffe547b43fd24053b0c`. Loci: L005.

The crop shows on, then an s with a raised apostrophe, a dotted i, the tall crossed t and the connected ending of s'intéresse, followed by au cas où les. These letter runs support the complete wording shared by A and B and the lexical part of C, and replace H's suppose/illegible sequence. The small raised mark over the middle e is compact and bent; its acute-versus-grave orientation remains insufficiently distinct. Preserve C's complete ordered accent states s'intéresse / s'intèresse / s'interesse at this word. The wording is high confidence, the accent qualification medium; his hand.

Crop `readers/026/C/crops/17_hemispheres.png`; SHA-256 `bc8007e979983732afe7caa213b32a0ec296127c27f4803b545928c245706b04`. Loci: L006.

A long horizontal run crosses the initial h, with a second oblique run through its lower middle; the remaining émisphères continues across the line without an extending strike. Preserve the full literal initial-h drawing from A026-G01 and the complete three-way scope qualification. The ordered interpretation is cancelled initial h with live continuation, then live whole word with retraced initial h, then whole-word cancellation signalled at the initial. The two crossing runs are concrete visible marks; the cancellation's full semantic scope remains medium confidence. All three states retain his hand. This retains A's three complete states, reorders their primary by the local crossing strokes, and records B's and C's distinct two-state sets separately.

## 07 — Raised equation, guide, and its five Sigma groups

Crop `readers/026/C/crops/04_inserted_formula.png`; SHA-256 `73263227b78ce266cba09272352a2b8ab7f4efaa54d14a19daa4daf25138ae78`. Loci: S02, L008, S03, S04, S05, S06.

S02 has a long upper run separated from the zigzag body, with a live lower alpha adjoining the foot. Retain A026-S02 exactly, including both complete head/retrace and independent-upper-run states and their local hand attribution.

S03 has a short upper arm meeting the body at the left apex, a clear live upper alpha and a clear live lower alpha. Retain A026-S03 exactly; its joined-head state is supported, high confidence.

S04 has a separate short upper run, a live upper alpha, and a dense angular overtrace at the lower-right index position. The lower form is consistent with alpha but its opaque crossing does not settle cancellation versus a heavily retraced live alpha. Keep A026-S04's literal paths and opaque fill, while recording all four complete C026-S04 attachment/state combinations, with the lower alpha qualified in each. The explicit state mapping replaces only the lower alpha token in each of C's four complete readings by unsure-alpha, preserves their order and every role/hand/attachment field, and leaves the upper live alpha firm. Primary: cancelled qualified lower alpha, head/retrace; then live qualified lower alpha with head/retrace; then those two lower states with independent upper run. The independent-run candidate alone has undetermined hand. Confidence medium; predecessor alpha identification remains qualified.

S05 has a separate short upper run, a dark upper-left mass above it, a second dark mass at the lower index position, and a clear live alpha followed by a comma and a small closed oval at the upper right. The two dark masses are retained literally. Preserve all 24 complete C026-S05 state combinations in their recorded order: cancelled/live lower alpha, cancelled upper-alpha/independent upper dark trace, oval 0/circle/o, and head/retrace/independent upper run. In this root set, replace the lower alpha in every state by unsure-alpha, and replace each cancelled upper-alpha candidate by cancelled unsure-alpha; no live upper-right alpha is qualified. This is an explicit token mapping of each C state, with its role, attachment and separately scoped hand fields retained. Use A026-S05's literal paths/fills and its primary 0/circle/o order. The upper dark trace is his hand under the cancelled-alpha reading and undetermined hand under the independent-trace reading. The short upper run has that same separate candidate-specific attribution. These retained alternatives do not add a mathematical operation. Confidence medium overall, low for recovery of the opaque predecessor letters.

L008: the long bowed guide runs under the inserted equation and curls down beside connexes. The raised equation is attached before connexes. Preserve A026-G03's complete placement and guide, with the local S03-S06 qualifications just specified. The visible equation includes et, a setminus before E, and an equals sign before S05. H's omission/replacement of the interlinear material and its connexes doubt are recorded from their own source markers. Placement and the readable words/signs are high confidence.

S06, after connexes, contains a zigzag with a right foot and a lower-right looped continuation, crossed by several diagonals. Preserve A026-S06's literal drawing and both complete cancelled readings, Sigma with lower alpha first and les second. Cancellation is high confidence; the cancelled content remains medium. Original C026-R03 is retained. C026-R02 parts 1, 2 and 3 remain qualified at S04 lower, S05 lower and S05 upper respectively; part 4 awaits S07. C026-R15's S05 oval component is retained without changing its single original parent/part structure.
